usageNotes: Retrieves a single firewall rule for an SDN vnet by its zero-based position in the ruleset. Requires SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate on the vnet's zone path; SDN must be enabled and the vnet must exist. Use this to inspect or verify a specific rule before modifying or deleting it — rule position is order-sensitive, so always confirm the pos index with the list endpoint first.

examples.summary: Fetch rule at position 0 for vnet 'prodvn1'

tips: Rule positions are zero-based and shift when rules are inserted or deleted above them — re-query the list after any mutation to confirm current positions.
The 'enable' field is an integer (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled), not a boolean.
If 'ipversion' is absent in the response, it was auto-derived from source/dest and may not have been explicitly set.
